images.author: unknown
images.why: Aerial crater view with turquoise water, steam and snow; emphasizes active Tupungatito rather than neighboring Tupungato. Native resolution unverified.

images.author: Alejo Contreras
images.why: Specialist-confirmed photograph of Tupungatito’s acid crater lake and steaming fumaroles. Strong identification fallback; resolution unverified and licence restricts commercial use.

images.author: Alejo Contreras
images.why: Alternative crater photograph showing vigorous fumarolic activity in the historically active vent. Resolution unverified; licence restricts commercial use.

images.author: SnapSaga
images.why: Photographer explicitly identifies Elbrus from Gum Bashi pass on a sunny November day; useful distant mountain composition with cropping space. Original-size endpoint; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: unknown
images.why: Classic twin snow-covered summits beneath clear blue sky, with broad glacier foreground. Original file linked without the website’s panoramic crop; native dimensions unverified.

images.author: Александр Синьковский
images.why: Snow-covered Elbrus explicitly identified by the photographer, with recorded iPhone camera provenance. Original-size endpoint; native dimensions and twin-summit crop suitability unverified.

images.author: Instituto Geográfico Militar; courtesy of Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Identity-confirmed aerial landscape from the west: Colachi is on the left, Acamarachi near the center. A left-focused crop is essential. Resolution unverified; licence restricts commercial use.

images.author: Instituto Geográfico Militar; courtesy of Oscar González-Ferrán
images.why: Aerial photograph explicitly identifying Colachi’s summit at upper left and its distinctive lava flows. Documentary fallback rather than an ideal cone portrait; resolution unverified.

images.author: Ingemmet
images.why: Institutionally credited photograph explicitly identifying Casiri in Tacna, avoiding similarly named lakes and neighboring volcanoes. Available link is a thumbnail; the 2,000-pixel preference is not verified.

images.author: INGEMMET / AFP
images.why: Dramatic ash column above Ubinas against blue sky, with volcanic slopes and rocky foreground; strong vertical emphasis for 9:10. Native resolution unverified.

images.author: Stringer
images.why: Recognizable erupting Ubinas with a large ash plume and a foreground observer providing scale. Original CDN image; native dimensions unverified.
